feed.title: Barriers of Mobility Blog
feed.subtitle: Stories, experiences and research findings on visa barriers faced by non-EU students in Erasmus+ and mobility programs.

entry.title: The Lengthy and Uncertain Czech Visa Process from Türkiye
entry.summary: A Turkish student's experience of the long waiting times, expensive certified translations, and uncertainties when applying for a Czech visa for Erasmus.

entry.title: Document Preparation and Distant Consulate Struggles
entry.summary: A Turkish student's experience of the biggest challenges during the visa process: rushed document preparation and having to travel far to the consulate with very limited time.

entry.title: Double Visa Rejection: My Italian Student Visa Nightmare
entry.summary: A Turkish student's experience of being rejected twice for an Italian student visa despite full financial proof, scholarship acceptance, and complete documentation.

entry.title: From Visa Struggles to Personal Growth: My Erasmus Journey
entry.summary: A Turkish student's full Erasmus experience — from the stressful visa process, extra costs, and travel to another city, to personal development, cultural adaptation, and returning more confident.

entry.title: My Visa Refusal Process
entry.summary: A Turkish university student's disappointing experience of having their visa refused for an Erasmus representative meeting in Ancona, Italy, despite complete documentation and official invitations.

entry.title: Overcoming Invisible Barriers: My Three Visa Experiences
entry.summary: A Turkish law student's honest reflections on three different visa applications — tourist, Erasmus, and cultural — and the psychological and practical challenges of the process.

entry.title: The Polish Visa Appointment Nightmare in Türkiye
entry.summary: A Turkish student's frustrating experience trying to secure a Polish visa appointment, dealing with bots, agencies, blocked websites, and extremely high fees.
